cards.front: What does the denominator of a fraction tell you?
cards.back: The number of equal parts the whole is split into. It is the bottom number.
cards.say: What does the denominator of a fraction tell you? The number of equal parts the whole is split into. It is the bottom number.

cards.front: What does the numerator of a fraction tell you?
cards.back: How many of the equal parts we have. It is the top number.
cards.say: What does the numerator of a fraction tell you? How many of the equal parts we have. It is the top number.

cards.back: A fraction with 1 on top, such as 1/2, 1/3 or 1/10.
cards.say: What is a unit fraction? A fraction with one on top, such as one half, one third or one tenth.

cards.front: A shape has 5 equal parts and 3 are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
cards.say: A shape has five equal parts and three are shaded. What fraction is shaded? Three fifths

cards.front: How many quarters make a whole?
cards.say: How many quarters make a whole? Four quarters. Four quarters equals one whole.

cards.front: How many thirds make a whole?
cards.say: How many thirds make a whole? Three thirds.
What is one half of ten? Five. Share ten into two equal groups.
What is one half of one hundred? Fifty
What is one quarter of twenty? Five. Share twenty into four equal groups.
What is one quarter of one hundred? Twenty five
What is one third of twelve? Four. Share twelve into three equal groups.
What is one fifth of thirty? Six
What is one tenth of fifty? Five
What is three quarters of eight? Six. One quarter of eight is two, so three quarters is three times two equals six.
What is two thirds of nine? Six. One third of nine is three, so two thirds is two times three equals six.
What is three tenths of forty? Twelve. One tenth of forty is four, so three tenths is three times four equals twelve.
Fill the gap: one half equals the missing number over four. Two. One half equals two quarters.
Fill the gap: one half equals the missing number over eight. Four. One half equals four eighths.
Fill the gap: one half equals five over the missing number. Ten. One half equals five tenths.
Fill the gap: two quarters equals one over the missing number. Two. Two quarters is the same as one half.

cards.back:
1/3
The more parts you cut a whole into, the smaller each part is.
cards.say: Which is bigger: one third or one quarter? One third. The more parts you cut a whole into, the smaller each part is.

cards.back:
4/5
The parts are the same size, and 4 parts is more than 2 parts.
cards.say: Which is bigger: two fifths or four fifths? Four fifths. The parts are the same size, and four parts is more than two parts.
Which is bigger: one half or three quarters? Three quarters. One half equals two quarters, and three quarters is more than two quarters.

cards.front: What do we call fractions that name the same amount?
cards.say: What do we call fractions that name the same amount? Equivalent fractions, such as one half and two quarters.
